about: Design and derived figures the engine draws once per run (kind draw), derives (kind derived, formula over other figure defaults) or holds (kind fixed), from Saint Jude Setting Bible Part VI and the Parts it cites. Dollars are 1975 dollars; *_m keys are USD millions. pools is the Part VI 9.3A allocation table (family shares sum to 100). Checked by tools/check_saintjude_pools.py.

population_metro_m.note: the 1975 figure is Fixed; only its later path is Open

population_decline_pct.note: positive number is a loss; drawn once and held unless the run moves it

population_rate_max_step_pts.note: rule: the rate moves toward a new value by at most a third of a point a year; a change needs a dated cause

population_growth_cap_pct_before_1990.note: rule: growth capped at 0.5 percent a year before 1990

population_change_requires_dated_cause.note: slow, stop or reverse the fall only for a cause the run can date

made_men_sabatini.note: default set inside the range at a non-round value (Part III 3.2 as revised); Part VI 9 uses the range midpoint (made_men_sabatini_mid)

made_men_pellegrino.extended_requires: a dated cause (Part III 3.2; Part VI 9.9 item 2)
made_men_pellegrino.note: default 45 stated in Part III 3.2; Part VI 9 also uses it as the midpoint

made_men_ferrante.note: default set inside the range at a non-round value (Part III 3.2 as revised); Part VI 9 uses the range midpoint (made_men_ferrante_mid)

made_men_total.note: sum of the drawn defaults; ranges sum 160 to 200, about 180 to 190 (Part III 3.2)

executive_share.note: unsourced; each of underboss and consigliere gets this share of the boss's receipts

pad_sergeant_weekly_usd.note: unsourced; sergeant tier weekly envelope; bible 7.5 prints $100

pad_patrolman_weekly_usd.note: unsourced; patrolman tier weekly envelope; bible 7.5 prints $30

pad_envelope_mean_check.note: unsourced; derivation check: officer-weighted mean of the three tiers must equal pad_mean_envelope_usd_year/52 within $1
